source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 935 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 935 was established by Ordinance No. 29650, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 25, 2015. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 935 is established on property generally bounded by Edgefield Avenue and Willomet Avenue, north of Stafford Avenue. The size of PD 935 is approximately 5.32 acres. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this district:

(1) OPEN SPACE means an area that is accessible to all occupants of the Property and principally open to the sky but allows for architectural elements such as colonnades, pergolas, and gazebos.

(2) TANDEM PARKING means one parking space in front of another parking space, making it necessary to pass through one parking space to gain vehicular access to the other parking space.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 935A: development plan. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN

(a) Except as provided in this section, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 935A). If there is conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Development plans may be submitted in phases or for a portion of any part of the Property. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District is subject to DIR in this district, etc. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.107. ACCESSORY USES

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the TH-1(A) Townhouse District apply.

(b) Single family.

(1) Front yard. Except as provided in this subsection, minimum front yard is ten feet.

(A) For interior lots, no minimum front yard.

(B) For lots fronting on Edgefield Avenue, no minimum front yard.

(2) Side and rear yard. Except as provided in this subsection, no minimum side and rear year.

(A) For lots along the perimeter of the Property, excluding those lots with frontage on Edgefield Avenue, minimum side and rear yard is five feet.

(B) For lots with frontage on Edgefield Avenue, minimum setback from the western Property line is 25 feet.

(3) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 60.

(4) Height. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 38 feet. For lots within 30 feet of the southern property line, maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(5) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 1,500 square feet. The average lot size must be 2,500 square feet.

(6) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.109. OFF-STREET PARKING

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Shared access development.

(1) For lots fronting on Willomet Avenue, a minimum of two off-street parking spaces are required. If tandem parking is used to satisfy this requirement, the tandem parking spaces must have a depth of at least 40 feet

(2) Two off-street parking spaces per dwelling unit must be provided for at least 70 percent of the dwelling units.

(3) Except as provided in this paragraph, up to 30 percent of the dwelling units may provide one off-street parking space per dwelling unit. Lots fronting on Willomet Avenue are excluded from this requirement.

(4) Guest parking must be provided at a ratio of one parking space for each five dwelling units.

(5) Except for lots fronting on Willomet Avenue, garage doors for a residential use located less than 20 feet from a street or alley must be equipped with an automatic garage door opener. The automatic garage door opener must be maintained in working order at all times. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.111. LANDSCAPING

(a) In general.

(1) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(2) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Single family uses. A minimum of three trees, a minimum of two caliper inches each, must be provided for each platted lot.

(c) Open space. A minimum of 7,200 square feet of open space must be provided in the location shown on the development plan.

(d) Tree preservation area.

(1) In general. A minimum of 9,370 square feet of tree preservation area must be provided in the location as shown on the development plan.

(2) Best practices. In order to establish a living buffer at the perimeter of the Property, best practices must be used to preserve healthy trees existing on February 25, 2015 based on advice given by an ISA certified or highly credentialed arborist for the tree preservation area as shown on the development plan.

(3) Tree removal permit. Except for the removal of understory, a tree removal permit must be approved prior to the removal of any protected tree in this area located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Shared Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.113. SHARED ACCESS.

Shared access developments are limited to a maximum of 60 individual lots with a minimum of one shared access point for every 30 individual lots. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.114. SIDEWALKS.

(a) A sidewalk with a minimum unobstructed width of five feet must be provided along Willomet Avenue.

(b) Sidewalks are not required along the shared access drive. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Ingress and egress to the Property is prohibited from Edgefield Avenue.

(b) Controlled access gates to the Property are prohibited on Willomet Avenue.

(c) Access to Elmo Street is limited to emergency access only. If a Knox Box is installed, final design and location must be approved by the Dallas Fire Department.

(d) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(e) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29650)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-935.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29650)
